Frequently asked questions

How do I place an order?

Click Order Now, add items to your basket, select delivery or collection, then complete payment securely.

How long does delivery take?

Standard delivery is 45–60 minutes. Collection is ready in approximately 15 minutes.

Can I cancel my order?

Contact us immediately on 020 8123 9229. Refunds are at our discretion depending on how quickly we're notified.

I have a food allergy

Please contact us directly before placing your order so we can advise on allergens in your drink.

Items missing from my order?

Call us on 020 8123 9229 immediately. We'll try to deliver missing items or arrange a refund.

How do I pay?

Pay securely by Visa or Mastercard online, or cash on delivery/collection. A £0.75 service charge applies.
